coverage_notes: The source requires a common readable 12-point font and gives Times New Roman as an example. TNR is an author-selected permitted branch, not the sole allowed family.
Guide dimensions are author-manuscript requirements; they are not inferred from a typeset published article.
Heading numbering/case, line numbering, page numbering, equation-number placement and reference footnote content need composition/content review; this profile preserves manuscript text and objects.
This version specifies textual-footnote references for new submissions from 2023-06-01. The retained source date permits review of later journal changes.
